titles.title: Cottonwood Tree in Spring

description: Whispy green and yellowish green cottonwood tree fills the entire canvas.  Blue sky is viable in the upper corners and through some of the branches, yet overall the painting is dominated by the blurred, flowing color of fresh green leaves and fingers of white branches.
title: Cottonwood Tree in Spring
